expansion: At home, lots of children's laughter
tagline: Stories from everyday family life that give you courage, with ideas for your own home
description: ZUVIK tells short, warm-hearted family stories from everyday German life: morning chaos and bedtime rituals, sibling arguments and reconciliation, grandparents, celebrations, school and daycare. Each story ends with practical ideas that parents can try right away.
author: ZUVIK editorial team

morgens-und-abends.name: Morning & evening
morgens-und-abends.description: Getting up, breakfast, going to school, dinner and bedtime rituals: how families make the edges of the day more relaxed.

geschwister.name: siblings
geschwister.description: Fights over toys, jealousy of the baby, big siblings and little ones: stories about solidarity and reconciliation.

grosseltern-und-generationen.name: Grandparents & generations
grosseltern-und-generationen.description: Grandma, Grandpa and the rest of the family: memories, visits, farewells and what generations learn from each other.

feste-und-jahreszeiten.name: Festivals & Seasons
feste-und-jahreszeiten.description: Saint Martin, Advent, Easter, summer holidays and autumn rain: how families experience the year together.

schule-und-kita.name: School & daycare
schule-und-kita.description: Getting used to it, the first day of school, homework, friendships and bad grades: stories about daycare and classrooms.

zusammenleben-zuhause.name: Living together at home
zusammenleben-zuhause.description: Pocket money, household services, screen time, moving and family advice: how a home works for everyone.
